tip.en: HR hovered around 90–99 for over a minute at the start before you began moving — likely a watch-start delay or brief pause. Worth noting as it inflates the "moving time" baseline.
tip.zh: 出发前心率在90–99之间徘徊超过一分钟，可能是手表延迟启动或短暂停留，会轻微干扰移动时间基准。

title.en: Cardiac Ramp Into the First Wall

tip.en: HR jumped from 128 to 143 in under 20 seconds as grade spiked to 6.2% — your body hadn't settled after the flat opening and was already taxed before the sustained 20% pitches ahead.
tip.zh: 坡度升至6.2%时，心率在不到20秒内从128飙至143——身体尚未从平路开段恢复，就要迎接前方持续的20%坡度。

tip.en: Grade peaked at 21.8% here yet HR was already dropping (160→156) after its peak at idx 400 — suggesting you slowed dramatically enough that cardiac output fell even on the steepest pitch. Pace confirms it: you were grinding at 7–9 min/km on near-vertical terrain.
tip.zh: 坡度在此达到21.8%峰值，但心率已从顶点开始下降（160→156），说明你放慢到足以让心输出量下降。配速数据印证：在接近垂直的地形上你以7–9分/千米艰难爬行。

title.en: HR Ceiling Reached on Second Prolonged Climb
title.zh: 第二段长坡触及心率上限

tip.en: 164–165 bpm sustained across a 10–14% grade section at km 0.8–0.9 — this matches your Catalina 10K max HR and is the physiological ceiling of this run. This is where the effort cost of today's route concentrates.
tip.zh: 在0.8–0.9千米的10–14%坡段，心率持续维持在164–165次/分，与Catalina 10K最大心率一致，是本次跑步的生理上限，也是今日路线体力消耗最集中之处。

tip.en: Your only 166 bpm reading of the entire run occurs here on a mild 1.5% grade — the cumulative climb load finally peaked. Compare this to your Catalina 10K where 166 was also the max: you're hitting the same ceiling on a 3.7 km run, suggesting fatigue or pacing was more aggressive than it felt.
tip.zh: 全程唯一的166次/分出现在此处1.5%的缓坡——累积爬升负荷在此达到顶点。与Catalina 10K相比，该次数也是166：一次3.7千米的短跑却触及相同上限，提示疲劳或配速比主观感受更激进。

tip.en: After cresting at 153.9 m you enter a sustained 7–9% downgrade. HR is already drifting down from 152 to 150, but pace is only 7:43 — you're not using the gravity assist, which will show up as a slower second-half average.
tip.zh: 越过153.9米高点后进入持续7–9%的下坡，心率从152缓降至150，但配速仅7:43——你没有利用重力优势，这将拖低后半段平均配速。

title.en: Steepest Earned Descent — Legs Under Load

tip.en: Grade hit -10.8% here and would reach -13% within seconds; you were still carrying 152 bpm from the prolonged climb above 150 m. Quad eccentric load on this stretch is the main injury risk of the whole run.
tip.zh: 此处坡度达-10.8%，数秒内将达-13%；你仍带着152次/分的心率从高于150米处下来，这段路对股四头肌的离心负荷是全程主要受伤风险点。

tip.en: HR finally settles to 146 bpm on flat ground at km 2.2 — the first time it's this low since the first 200 m. It took nearly 1.5 km of mixed terrain after the summit to recover here, which tracks with the density of climbing in this short run.
tip.zh: 心率在2.2千米的平路上终于降至146次/分——这是自开跑200米后的首次低谷。在峰顶之后经过近1.5千米的混合地形才恢复至此，与本次短跑中密集的爬升量相符。

title.zh: 跑途停顿打断恢复节律

tip.en: Pace slows to 52+ min/km at km 2.6 and HR drops sharply from 143 to 132 over ~20 seconds — a clear stop or traffic wait. Coming just as the body was settling into steady-state, this reset will cost you momentum into the next climb.
tip.zh: 2.6千米处配速降至52分/千米以上，心率在约20秒内从143骤降至132——明显停顿或等待红灯。正值身体进入稳定状态之际，这次停顿将削弱你应对下一段爬坡的节奏。

title.en: Best Pace of the Run — Post-Descent Flow
title.zh: 全程最快配速——下坡流畅段

tip.en: 3:44 min/km at km 2.9 on a -8.9% grade with HR at only 138 — you're finally letting gravity work. This is the best cardiac-efficiency moment of the entire run: fast pace, low HR, downhill assistance all aligned.
tip.zh: 2.9千米处以3:44/千米的配速在-8.9%坡度跑动，心率仅138次/分——终于让重力为你工作。这是全程心脏效率最佳时刻：快配速、低心率、下坡助力三者同时对齐。

title.en: Staircase or Trail Drop — GPS Compression Artifact
title.zh: 台阶或山道急降——GPS压缩异常

tip.en: Grade reads -39.6% and altitude drops 2 m in 2 seconds — almost certainly a staircase or very short technical drop near km 3.4. HR holds at 156–158 and barely reacts, confirming it was brief. Flag this section if you feel any ankle or knee soreness afterward.
tip.zh: 坡度读数达-39.6%，2秒内下降2米，几乎可以确定是3.4千米附近的台阶或短促技术性下坡。心率维持在156–158且几乎无波动，确认这段极短。若事后感到踝关节或膝盖不适，需重点关注该段。

title.zh: 下坡结束——身体重新校准

tip.en: After the prolonged chaotic descent (grades as steep as -49%) HR is at 130 and pace normalizes around 9 min/km on flat ground. You've shed 37 m of altitude in under 100 m horizontal — the downhill dose on this run is unusually compressed for its distance.
tip.zh: 经历坡度最陡达-49%的长段乱序下坡后，心率降至130次，平路配速恢复至约9分/千米。在不足100米的水平距离内下降了37米——本次跑步中下坡剂量相对于其距离异常集中。
